name: TextArea
summary: Collect multiline text with shared label, description, and validation parts.

useWhen: Collecting a paragraph or other multiline text value.
avoidWhen: For a short single-line value; use TextField.
For formatted or structured rich text; use TextEditor.

obligations: Uses native textarea attributes and shared Mux field validation semantics.

behavior: Uses native textarea attributes and shared Mux field validation semantics.
Root owns the field: value, defaultValue, and onChange go on TextArea.Root, and Root's onChange receives the new string, not an event.
Root also takes size, disabled, invalid, required, and readOnly.
TextArea.TextArea is the native textarea, so name, rows, maxLength, and placeholder go on it.
A named TextArea submits its text; the name goes on TextArea.TextArea, not Root.
TextArea.TextArea also takes the native onChange, which receives the change event and runs alongside Root's.
maxLength stops input at the limit and shows no message. TextArea has no character counter and does not grow with its text.
TextArea.Description is linked to the textarea.
TextArea.Error appears only while the field is invalid, and is linked to the textarea.
accessibility: Uses native textarea attributes and shared Mux field validation semantics.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
